backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing vendor management, product catalog, order processing, team member management, and admin authorization with blob storage and access control mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features for vendor overview, product drill-down views, admin product editing, and React Query mutation hooks with associated files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components including dashboards, forms, authentication flows, and UI components with their specific functionality and type handling.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles defining OKLCH color system with custom CSS variables for light and dark modes using nature-inspired color palette.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the GreenPlantz React application with root div and module script reference.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with protected routes, React Query client with retry logic, error boundaries, and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/AdminRegistratio: Admin registration component handling Internet Identity authentication, profile setup, and automatic admin privilege granting for greenplantz2020@gmail.com with loading states.
frontend/src/components/CommissionEditor: Dialog component for editing vendor commission settings, supporting both percentage and fixed amount commission types with validation and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React error boundary component that catches and displays errors with context-aware messaging for auth, network, and router errors, including detailed error info in development mode.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with header navigation, authentication controls, dashboard routing based on user role (admin/vendor), and footer.
frontend/src/components/LoadingSpinner.t: Simple reusable loading spinner component with optional text display using Lucide icons.
frontend/src/components/OrderCreationFor: Form component for creating new orders with fields for order details and shipping address, using mutation hook for submission.
Displays list of orders with expandable details, showing order status, vendor assignment, and shipping information with nested VendorAssignment and ShippingDetailsForm components.
frontend/src/components/PaymentManagemen: Manages order payment statuses, displaying pending and completed payments with ability to mark orders as paid.
frontend/src/components/PhotoUploader.ts: Component for uploading photos with watermark detection and automatic watermarking. Adds 'greenplantz.com' watermarks at three positions (top-left, center, bottom-right) and rejects images that already contain watermarks.
frontend/src/components/ProductEditDialo: Dialog component for admin to edit product details including name, description, price, quantity, enabled status, and photos. Handles photo uploads with progress tracking and validates form inputs before submission.
frontend/src/components/ProductList.tsx: Displays vendor products in a grid with photo previews, pricing, and inline quantity editing. Shows alerts for disabled products and prevents modifications to admin-disabled items.
frontend/src/components/ProductManagemen: Admin dashboard component for managing all vendor products with search functionality and enable/disable toggles. Displays summary statistics for total, enabled, and disabled products across all vendors.
frontend/src/components/ProductUploadFor: Form component for vendors to upload new products with name, description, price, quantity, and photos. Requires at least 2 photos and displays success message with SKU information after upload.
frontend/src/components/ProtectedAdminRo: Route guard that checks user authentication and admin role, redirecting non-admin users to home page. Renders AdminDashboard only for authenticated admin users.
frontend/src/components/ProtectedVendorR: Route guard that verifies user authentication and vendor profile existence, showing appropriate error messages for unauthenticated users or missing vendor profiles. Renders VendorDashboard for valid vendor users.
frontend/src/components/ShippingDetailsF: Form component for updating order shipping details and tracking information, with loading states and mutation handling via useUpdateOrderShipping hook.
frontend/src/components/TeamMemberDialog: Dialog component for creating and editing team members with form validation, Principal ID handling, and toast notifications for success/error states.
frontend/src/components/TeamMemberManage: Team member management interface with search, filtering, status toggling, and deletion capabilities, displaying active/inactive member counts and a data table.
frontend/src/components/VendorAssignment: Component for assigning vendors to orders with a dropdown selector of active vendors and mutation handling via useAssignVendorToOrder hook.
frontend/src/components/VendorManagement: Vendor management interface with search, status toggling, deletion, commission editing, and product viewing capabilities, calculating vendor statistics from products and orders.
frontend/src/components/VendorProductsVi: Displays a grid of products for a specific vendor with product images, SKU, enabled status, and edit functionality via ProductEditDialog.
frontend/src/components/VendorRegistrati: Vendor registration form component that handles Internet Identity login and saves both user and vendor profiles with business details (name, contact, address, pincode).
frontend/src/components/VendorSuggestion: Component that finds and displays nearby vendors based on order shipping address pincode and product name, showing vendor details and availability status.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for user profiles, vendor profiles, products, orders, admin operations, and role management, all using the actor instance for backend communication.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a nature-inspired color palette (forest greens, moss, sage) for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page displaying stats (total orders, unassigned, pending payment, active vendors) and tabs for managing orders, creating orders, payments, vendors, products, and team members.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero section promoting GreenPlantz as India's plant marketplace, featuring navigation to vendor registration or admin access, and a features section highlighting product management, order assignment, and payment tracking.
frontend/src/pages/VendorDashboard.tsx: Vendor dashboard displaying order stats (total, pending, completed), product upload form, vendor's product list, and assigned orders with payment status.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: TypeScript type definitions for the application including UserProfile, VendorProfile, Product, Order, TeamMember, CommissionType, and ExtendedActorInterface defining all backend canister methods.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters and sessionStorage, supporting both regular query strings and hash-based routing with persistence across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extending colors (using OKLCH color space), container settings, border radius variables, custom fonts (Inter, Poppins), shadows, and accordion animations.
project_state.json: Project state file defining a two-sided marketplace (GreenPlantz) connecting garden nursery vendors with customers, featuring vendor/admin portals, product management with INR pricing, image watermarking, location-based vendor assignment, and configurable commission rates. Contains 17 existing features including vendor registration, product upload, order management, admin controls, and SKU generation logic.
